subtasks: Complete the equation by selecting the correct missing number or operator and placing it on the pad, then reset the robot arm.
Using the left gripper, pick up the leftmost blue number 1 and place it upright and centered on the empty pad to the right of the equals sign.

Retract the open left hand. Use the right gripper to pick up the blue number 1 now near the center of the table, and place it upright in the center of the empty answer pad to the right of the equals sign.
The blue 1 is on the answer pad. Keep both grippers fully open, lift the right gripper clear and return both arms to their initial poses.
